name: ESSAI 2026
venue: European Summer School on Artificial Intelligence, Vienna, Austria
description: The 4th European Summer School on Artificial Intelligence (ESSAI) will be held in Vienna, Austria, from 6 to 10 July 2026 and targets PhD students and young researchers working across all AI sub‑disciplines. The program offers introductory and advanced courses, specialized tutorials on Bilateral AI and Digital Humanism, and a rich social programme including a reception at the Vienna City Hall. ESSAI is co‑located with the 5th ACM Europe Digital Humanism Summer School and features over 30 lecturers across six parallel tracks, fostering networking and interdisciplinary collaboration.

name: OpenEuroLLM Winter School
description: The 2026 Winter School on Multilinguality in LLM Development and Evaluation is organized by the Nordic Language Processing Laboratory together with the University of Oslo in Norway. It targets NLP researchers, especially those from EuroHPC consortium countries, and offers technical presentations, hands‑on elements, and discussions on multilingual large language models and their evaluation. The event is held at the Skeikampen conference hotel north of Oslo, includes subsidized participation, group bus transfers from Oslo Airport, and provides meals and accommodation options.

name: Probabilistic AI School
description: The ProbAI School 2026 is a Probabilistic AI School taking place in Vilnius, Lithuania. It aims to provide an inclusive educational environment covering state‑of‑the‑art machine learning and artificial intelligence topics for students, academics, and industry professionals. Participants will have the opportunity to learn from leading experts and network within the AI community.

name: BMVA Computer Vision Summer School
description: The 29th BMVA Computer Vision Summer School takes place at Durham University in Durham, England. It offers an intensive five‑day program of lectures and lab sessions covering a broad spectrum of computer‑vision topics delivered by leading researchers from the UK and abroad. The school is aimed at graduate students and early‑career researchers who want to deepen their knowledge and network with experts in the field.

name: Oxford Machine Learning Summer School 2026
venue: Oxford ML School, Oxford, United Kingdom
description: Upskill in the latest AI theory and applications with OxML 2026's three specialised tracks. Learn from world‑renowned experts from frontier AI labs in academia and industry in a unique and customisable experience. Choose any combination of tracks to suit your learning goals.

name: Robotics, Perception and Learning (RPL) Summer School
venue: Department for Robotics, Perception and Learning, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden
description: The RPL Summer School 2026 is a six‑day event organized by the Department for Robotics, Perception and Learning at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, Sweden. It brings together doctoral and postdoctoral researchers to discuss topics such as machine learning, computer vision, robotics, human‑robot interaction, planning and decision making through keynotes, industry talks, brainstorming sessions and student presentations. The programme is hosted at the Happy Tammsvik resort and includes indoor and outdoor ice‑breaker activities, with all accommodation, meals and materials provided free of charge.

name: Machine Learning Crash Course at MALGA
description: The MLCC2026 Summer School – Machine Learning Crash Course – provides an introduction to fundamental machine‑learning concepts and algorithms. It is aimed at undergraduate and graduate students, as well as professionals, and is open to participants from any university after a selection process. The five‑day in‑person program in Genoa combines theoretical lectures with hands‑on lab sessions and includes a final test consisting of notebook work and a report.

name: UK Robotics Summer School
venue: National Robotarium, Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
description: The UK Robotics Summer School 2026 is a five‑day program held in Edinburgh that brings together master’s‑level students and industry practitioners to explore advanced robotics topics. It offers expert‑led lectures, tutorials and hands‑on sessions covering bio‑inspired robotics, healthcare robotics, generative AI, safe AI and real‑world applications, with industry presentations and networking opportunities. The event takes place at the National Robotarium, Heriot‑Watt University and includes meals and a special summer‑school dinner.

name: International Summer School for Advanced Studies on Biometrics, Behavior, and Vision
description: The 2026 Biometrics Summer School takes place at Hotel Dei Pini in Porto Conte near Alghero, Sardinia, Italy. It focuses on the impact of generative AI and large foundation models on biometric and human‑recognition technologies, covering machine learning, image understanding, signal analysis, neuroscience, robotics, forensic and digital forensics. The program is aimed at PhD students, post‑docs, researchers and professionals such as forensic examiners and police officers, offering intensive lectures by leading experts, hands‑on sessions, and the possibility of scholarships.

name: Winter School on Ethical, Legal, and Societal (ELS) aspects of AI and AS at Umeå University
description: The Winter School on Ethical, Legal, and Societal aspects of AI and Autonomous Systems brings together researchers and students to discuss responsible AI. It offers lectures, multidisciplinary hands‑on training, a poster session and a social program to foster networking and professional exchange. The three‑day event takes place at Umeå University in Sweden from 11 to 13 March 2026.

name: Winter School on Social Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Multimedia (SoRAIM 2026)
description: The ACM Europe Winter School SoRAIM’27 focuses on social robotics, artificial intelligence, and multimedia. It targets PhD students and early‑career researchers, offering lectures, hands‑on sessions, and informal networking in a mountain setting. The venue in Escandille, Autrans, in the Vercors mountains near Grenoble provides opportunities for outdoor activities and interdisciplinary collaboration.

name: Northern Lights Deep Learning Winter School
venue: UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Tromsø, Norway
description: The 2027 Winter School on Deep Learning is part of the Northern Lights Deep Learning Conference in Tromsø, Norway. It runs from 11 January to 15 January 2027 and focuses on state-of-the-art deep-learning methods such as image classification, object detection, segmentation, time-series prediction and speech recognition. The school targets researchers and practitioners who want to exchange ideas, foster collaborations, and learn about recent advances in the field.

name: Annual Nepal AI School (ANAIS)
description: The 7th Annual Nepal AI School is a two‑week intensive program that runs from 28 December 2026 to 7 January 2027 at Kathmandu World School in Kathmandu, Nepal. It offers 11 days of AI lectures, hands‑on labs, and project work covering fundamentals to cutting‑edge topics such as geometric deep learning, generative modeling, and neuro‑symbolic AI. The school targets senior undergraduates, graduate students, PhD candidates, faculty, and industry professionals, aiming to build AI expertise and foster collaboration across South Asia.

name: EEML Summer School
description: The Eastern European Machine Learning Summer School takes place in Cetinje, Montenegro from 27 July to 1 August 2026. It brings together leading researchers from academia and industry to deliver lectures and tutorials on recent advances in machine learning. The program targets graduate students and early‑career researchers interested in deep learning, reinforcement learning, and related topics, offering networking opportunities with the European AI community.

name: Mediterranean Summer School
description: The Mediterranean Machine Learning (M2L) Summer School is a five‑day event that brings together AI experts to deliver keynotes, lectures and hands‑on sessions. It targets doctoral and outstanding master students, as well as academics and practitioners, focusing on topics such as computer vision, natural language processing, generative models and reinforcement learning. The school also provides networking opportunities through poster sessions, social activities and informal interactions with speakers and sponsors.

name: Summer School on Multimodal Foundation Models and Generative AI
venue: Institut National des Postes et Télécommunications, Rabat, Morocco
description: The 2nd edition of the AI Summer School on Multimodal Foundation Models and Generative AI is a five‑day immersive program jointly organized by MoroccoAI, INPT, IMT Nord Europe, and Soft Centre. It targets young researchers, Ph.D. students, post‑docs, senior researchers and professionals, offering expert lectures, hands‑on labs, and networking opportunities to build the next generation of AI leaders in Morocco. Participants will receive a clear overview of state‑of‑the‑art research, practical implementation experience, and access to a strong network of AI enthusiasts across the country.

name: AthNLP Summer School 2026
description: The Athens Natural Language Processing (AthNLP) Summer School 2026 will be held at the campus of NCSR Demokritos in Athens, Greece. The program, organized by a consortium of research centers and universities, offers intensive training on state‑of‑the‑art NLP methods for graduate students and early‑career researchers. It runs from 2 to 8 September and is followed by the 14th EETN Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Chania.

name: Advanced Artificial Intelligence: GenAI & Deep Unsupervised Learning
venue: Lady Margaret Hall, Oxford, United Kingdom
description: The Advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning summer school at Lady Margaret Hall focuses on generative AI and deep unsupervised learning techniques. It provides both theoretical foundations and hands‑on experience with clustering, GANs, self‑supervised learning and related models across real‑world applications. The programme is aimed at STEM students with intermediate AI/ML knowledge who wish to gain career‑relevant skills and prepare for graduate research.

name: AI4Science Summer School
description: The 2nd Summer School on Advancing Scientific Discovery with AI brings together researchers, PhD students and post‑doctoral scholars to explore how artificial intelligence can accelerate scientific research. It covers topics such as machine learning for data analysis, AI‑driven experimental design, generative models, and the integration of AI with physical simulations, featuring hands‑on workshops using Python libraries like NumPy and PyTorch. The program aims to equip participants with practical AI skills for scientific discovery and foster interdisciplinary collaboration.

name: LUT Summer School
description: LUT Summer School is a one‑week intensive program held at LUT University’s Lappeenranta campus, offering courses on sustainability, climate action, marketing, management and the intersection of business and technology. The programme is aimed at bachelor’s and master’s students from any university, combining classroom teaching, workshops, group projects and a social programme set in the Finnish summer environment. Participants receive 3 ECTS credits, access to campus facilities, and the opportunity to experience Finland’s nature while engaging with experts in sustainability and innovation.

name: 1st Internationa School on the Cognitive, Ethical, and Societal Dimensions of AI - AIces
description: AIces 2026 is the inaugural International School on the Cognitive, Ethical and Societal Dimensions of Artificial Intelligence, held in Porto–Maia, Portugal from 30 March to 2 April 2026. The four‑day event targets graduate and postgraduate students as well as industry practitioners, offering parallel courses, a symposium of short presentations, and open‑debate sessions on cognition, ethics and society. Participants can attend face‑to‑face or online, receive recordings for 45 days after the school, and obtain a certificate of participation.
